project_type: Local 'Brawl Hockey' tournament dashboard: Python stdlib http.server backend + pure-Python rules engine + vanilla JS control-room frontend (no framework, no third-party deps).
build_system: None. Run directly: `python3 app.py` serves http://127.0.0.1:8765. No bundler, no package manager.
test_framework: Python unittest (tests/test_tournament.py, 33 tests) + a Node vm-sandbox UI harness (tests/test_ui.cjs) that loads static/app.js into a stubbed DOM/fetch/confirm context and asserts on rendered HTML strings and simulated click dispatch.
build_command: No build step. Sanity check: `python3 -c 'import engine, app'`.
test_command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v  (33 tests, must stay green)  AND  node tests/test_ui.cjs  (must exit 0).
verification_instructions:
1) python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v -> OK, 33+ tests. 2) node tests/test_ui.cjs -> prints the pass lines, exit 0. 3) Live probe: a SINGLE shell script FILE under /projects/sandbox that starts `python3 app.py --no-browser --port

--data /tmp/t.json` in the background, curls /api/state, PUTs state through /api/state to exercise a clear-round cascade and an undo-restore, then kills the server. Must be one bash invocation because each bash call gets a fresh PID namespace that kills backgrounded servers; a guard also trips on literal port/host flags in the command string so keep those flags inside the script file.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. tournament.json is runtime data and gitignored.
setup_instructions: No setup. python3 and node are preinstalled (python3 3.9.25, node v22). Just run the test commands from the repo root /projects/sandbox/Autosurveryai.
environment_constraints: No third-party deps allowed. Schema stays version 4; do NOT change the engine data model. This is a frontend/UX task; engine.py should remain untouched (its view already exposes everything needed: view.<stage>.issues, .ready, .complete, .stale, .survivors, and top-level view.names_ok). Network access not required for the task.
contribution_requirements: Keep all 33 Python unit tests and the Node UI harness green. Extend tests/test_ui.cjs following its existing vm-sandbox + fetch-stub + click-dispatch patterns. Commit onto the already-checked-out branch feat/per-match-ranking (do NOT branch off main, do NOT push, do NOT open/merge PRs). Never use em dashes in content.
key_patterns: static/app.js is a single-file vanilla app. Key globals: `state` (the data), `view` (engine-computed, from server), `revision`, `token`. render() rebuilds #content innerHTML from state/view. Destructive actions live in the document 'click' dispatcher (search `document.addEventListener('click'`): 'clear-r2-game', 'clear-game', 'reset-stage', 'reset-all', plus 'r1-reroll' (rerollRound1Game via PUT /api/round1-lineup). These currently gate on window.confirm(). resetStage(key) clears a stage AND downstream; its cascade mapping is `key==='round2'?['round2','final']:[key]` and MUST be extended so round1 cascades to ['round1','round2','final']. Save pipeline: changed() marks dirty + debounced save(); save() PUTs {state,revision} to /api/state (guarded by X-Session-Token + revision; 409 on conflict) and reassigns state/view/revision from the echo. flush() awaits a clean save. Stage screens: round() -> round1 (To Live) / round2Page() (To Die); finalPage() (Rebirth). overview() computes `next=!view.names_ok?'settings':!view.round1.complete?'round1':!view.round2.complete?'round2':'final'` and renders a .round-path with an .accent class on the next step. notice(issues) renders view.<stage>.issues as .notice.warning. Reusable: .panel, panel(), title(), table(), notice(), .danger, .hint, .notice, .match-completion, .accent, .round-path, badge(), #save-status footer area, #result-dialog. reducedMotion() guards animations.
relevant_files: static/app.js (all UI logic, dispatcher, resetStage, save pipeline, overview, round pages)
static/style.css (reuse .panel/.danger/.hint/.notice/.notice.warning/.round-path/.accent/.match-completion; add any new classes here)
static/index.html (footer #save-status / #retry-save area for the Undo affordance; dialog markup)
engine.py (READ ONLY reference: round1_view/round2_view/evaluate expose issues/ready/complete/stale/survivors/names_ok; do not modify unless a readiness string genuinely must be added)
tests/test_ui.cjs (extend following its vm-sandbox + fetch-stub + click-dispatch patterns)
tests/test_tournament.py (keep green; reference for Python-side fixtures used by the Node harness)
README.md (document the new controls if behavior changes user-visibly)
directory_structure: Repo root /projects/sandbox/Autosurveryai: app.py (http server + CLI --port/--data/--no-browser), engine.py (rules), static/ (app.js, index.html, style.css), tests/ (test_tournament.py, test_ui.cjs), README.md, tournament.json (runtime, gitignored). Live-server probe scripts belong under /projects/sandbox (parent of repo).
